title: Ship the assistant into the existing storefront behind a flag
scenario: Kestrel wants the shopping assistant behind its 2023 search box with a strict rollout: two weeks of shadow mode, a growing percentage of customers, a live kill switch, fallback to the regular results on errors or a slow first word, and analytics without what customers typed.
task: Deterministic cohort buckets and mode resolution with a kill switch
Shadow mode that measures the assistant without rendering it
Live flag changes that abort in-flight requests without a reload
Fallback on error or slow first token, regular results one click away, human handoff
Analytics with a fixed schema and no query text or user id
acceptance: Cohorts stable, well spread, monotonic; kill switch wins
Shadow logs only; nothing new rendered
Kill switch takes effect live and aborts the stream
Fallback on error and slow first token; allowed analytics fields only

practices.label: Week 5 - feature flags, shadow mode, strangler fig, kill switch
Week 1 - streaming a model response into the UI
